infobox.title: ಲಿನಕ್ಸ್ ಸೆಟಪ್ — ಓಮಾರ್ಕಿ
infobox.imageCaption: Hyprland Wayland ಅಲಾಕ್ರಿಟಿ ಟರ್ಮಿನಲ್‌ನೊಂದಿಗೆ ಟೈಲಿಂಗ್ WM

lead:
ನಾನು ಚಲಾಯಿಸುತ್ತೇನೆ **Arch Linux via Omarchy** — an opinionated 'omakase' developer distribution created by DHH (David Heinemeier Hansson, creator of Ruby on Rails). Omarchy ships ಜೊತೆ Hyprland Wayland tiling WM, Neovim, Alacritty, Ghostty, ಮತ್ತು Tmux — a curated, pre-configured developer environment that skips weeks of manual configuration.

I set ನನ್ನ username to `libre` — consistent ಜೊತೆ the FOSS-first philosophy that runs through ನನ್ನ [[privacy-stack|ಗೌಪ್ಯತಾ ಸ್ಟಾಕ್]] ಮತ್ತು [[foss-coin|FOSS Coin]] ಯೋಜನೆ. I've forked Omarchy to a personal ಗಿಟ್‌ಹಬ್ repository so I can selectively apply upstream updates rather than taking everything DHH ships.

content.content:
**Omarchy** is described by DHH as 'omakase Arch Linux' — *omakase* being the Japanese restaurant concept where the chef selects the best dishes on your behalf. DHH applied this to Arch Linux: instead of spending weeks configuring a desktop from scratch, Omarchy gives you a complete, opinionated ಸೆಟಪ್ in 15–30 minutes.

The repository has ~22,000 ಗಿಟ್‌ಹಬ್ stars (as of April 2026). It installs from an ISO, wipes the dedicated drive, ಮತ್ತು applies full-disk encryption by default. The Super key is the command centre ಗಾಗಿ all shortcuts.
ನನ್ನ daily workflow is keyboard-driven ಮತ್ತು terminal-centric. Almost no GUI applications are used ಗಾಗಿ development work — everything goes through the terminal.

rows.ನಾನು ಅದನ್ನು ಏನು ಬಳಸುತ್ತೇನೆ: Session ಮತ್ತು window management — persistent sessions that survive terminal restarts
Primary editor — still learning Lua ಗಾಗಿ config customisation
Fuzzy file find → open in editor
AI agent in accept-all mode — terminal-native pair programmer I call 'P.I.'
On-demand socket activation — reduces idle RAM on ನನ್ನ constrained [[homelab|homelab]] VM

content.title: ಓಮಾರ್ಕಿ v3.4+ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಗಳು
content.content: Version 3.4 added Tmux by default (t alias), Claude Code as the default AI agent (cx alias, accept-all mode), hibernation enabled by default, ಮತ್ತು AI agent Tmux layouts: tdl, tdlm, tsl.

I've integrated **Claude Code** — I call it 'P.I.' (Personal Intelligence) in ನನ್ನ ಸೆಟಪ್ — as a terminal-native AI agent. I have a custom `CLAUDE.md` at `/home/libre/CLAUDE.md` that describes ನನ್ನ personal workflow context.

ನಾನು ಚಲಾಯಿಸುತ್ತೇನೆ Claude Code in accept-all mode (`cx` alias) — it reads files, writes code, ಮತ್ತು executes shell commands without asking ಗಾಗಿ confirmation at each step. The Omarchy skill file (`github.com/robzolkos/omarchy-skill`) extends this ಜೊತೆ Omarchy-specific context.

This has genuinely changed how I work: rather than memorising command syntax, I query in natural language ಮತ್ತು the agent executes the appropriate commands.

ನಾನು ಬಳಸುತ್ತೇನೆ OBS Studio ಗಾಗಿ screen recording ಮತ್ತು video production, ಜೊತೆ a specific audio configuration I tuned carefully:
- **Noise Gate:** Close threshold −32 dB / Open threshold −26 dB — eliminates background hiss between speech
- **RNNoise suppression:** AI-based noise cancellation plugin
- **Mic:** CMF Buds 2 Pro via PulseAudio

ನಾನು ಬಳಸುತ್ತೇನೆ **Shotcut** as ನನ್ನ video editor. The entire production pipeline is Linux-native ಮತ್ತು free software — no Adobe products anywhere.

content.title: ಆಕಸ್ಮಿಕ ಟರ್ಮಿನಲ್ ಅಳಿಸುವಿಕೆ — ನಾನು ಕಲಿತದ್ದು
content.content: I once accidentally removed all terminal emulators while cleaning packages. Recovery: Ctrl+Alt+F2 to drop to TTY2, log in, reinstall Alacritty or Ghostty via pacman from the framebuffer terminal. The TTY is always available even when the graphical session has no terminals — I know this the hard way now.

editHistory.summary: ಪೂರ್ಣ ಬರಹ: ಟರ್ಮಿನಲ್ ಕಾರ್ಯವಿಧಾನ, AI ಏಕೀಕರಣ, ಮಾಧ್ಯಮ ಸೆಟಪ್
